title: Nimble Egyptian Tofu Umm Ali
description: A mustardy, snappy, plant-based twist on the classic Egyptian dessert, packed with shio-koji, agemono-deep-fried tofu and toasted almond crunch.
instructions: Toss sweet potato cubes with 1 tsp smoked paprika and a pinch of salt, then roast in a single layer on a baking sheet for 20 minutes until tender.
While potatoes roast, heat 1 tbsp olive oil in a skillet over medium heat, add diced tofu, and pan-fry until golden on all sides; set aside.
In a small bowl, whisk together coconut milk, shio-koji, and whole grain mustard until smooth.

Add the roasted sweet potato, fried tofu, cherry tomatoes, raisins, toasted almond slices, and shredded coconut to a large baking dish; drizzle with the shio-koji mixture and gently toss to coat all ingredients.
Sprinkle the dish with extra toasted almond slices for crunch and a final dash of smoked paprika.
Bake uncovered for 10 minutes, until the caramelized edges brown and the mixture is fragrant.
Remove from oven, let cool for a few minutes, then plate the dish in a shallow bowl, spooning any remaining sauce over the top.
Garnish with a drizzle of olive oil and a sprinkle of fresh lime zest for a bright finish.
Serve warm as a hearty, mustardy vegan Umm Ali twist on a classic Egyptian dessert.
